name: ScriptName/filename mismatch
description: Flags a .psc file whose declared ScriptName doesn't match its path under the script root, aside from casing. An unqualified name is the file stem; Fallout 4 / Starfield A:B:C must end in A/B/C.psc after any layout folders the name does not include.
definition: Flags, as an `[error]`, a `.psc` file whose declared `ScriptName` doesn't match its path relative to the owning script root, aside from casing, since Papyrus resolves a script by that mapping and rejects a mismatch at compile time. An unqualified name is compared to the file stem only (e.g. `ScriptName Example` in `Other.psc`). In Fallout 4 / Starfield, `ScriptName A:B:C` must match `A/B/C.psc` under a script root — the same case-insensitive mapping `FunctionTable` and `.ppj` use — after ignoring leading layout folders that are not part of the ScriptName (for example FO4 `Base/` under `Scripts/Source`, or a DLC package folder the name does not start with). A namespaced script that exists is not a `Script:Struct`. Skyrim names stay a single segment. Only available when linting a file with a known path in the desktop app or CLI.
